Title: Seawatch Bay
Content: :box:Scientists at the marine science lab wonder if the Noctiluca scintillans' ability to produce light affects the probability of it surviving in Seawatch Bay.

The scientists collect data on how the number of Noctiluca scintillans in Seawatch Bay with the light-producing trait and without the light-producing trait has changed in relation to the predator population that eats them. The graph shows the data.
